summary: Vor Biopharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market program of up to $150,000,000 of common stock sold through William Blair and RBC Capital Markets as sales agents under a new sales agreement dated October 30, 2026; a prior Stifel sales agreement expired after $125 million was sold. Agents receive up to 3.0% commission, sales occur at prevailing market prices, and no escrow applies; last reported price was $20.91 on October 29, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and share overhang.
